title: Learn and belong
body: Learning windows are private and reflect enabled commands and your current permissions. Lore remains unavailable until authentic owner-approved chapters are published. Reading progress is saved; completing all three chapters earns Chair Historian once, with no Ottoman reward.

fields.command: Search enabled commands available to you.
fields.time: Choose an offered recap window; chat recaps belong in main chat and event recaps in the bot channel.

steps: Open /help for a searchable quick reference or /tutorial for learning paths.
Choose a path and command; use Next and Back to explore its fields and example.
Practice is an example review only: it never executes a command or spends Ottomans.
Use Continue for your saved lesson or Restart to start that lesson again.
Lore content is owner-authored. Read each available chapter in order using the private reader controls.
